pcs.pc_description: Infer the current accounting methods followed for sustainability reporting.
Interpret the current Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions accounting.
Collect data from identified sources for Sustainability Reporting.
Maintain data to support greenhouse gas inventory calculation.
Calculate greenhouse gas emissions using the appropriate methodologies.
Review the application of the Business Responsibility Reporting (BRR) and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR) principles of the organisation.
Escalate violations of SOPs to the management.
Maintain records of breaches of sustainability SOPs with analysis.
Identify emission reduction opportunities.
Perform carbon footprint calculations for a product, service or process using the defined carbon footprint calculation tools or software.

pcs.pc_description: Identify and track key sustainability metrics related to procurement.
Check SOPs for data collection and PoCs and maintain records related to key sustainability metrics.
Assist in the analysis of procurement data for business insights and effective decision- making.
Assist SCS specialist in developing procurement policies and their adoption/compliance.
Report progress on sustainable procurement practices to the SCS Specialist.
Support procurement teams in transition by providing innovative solutions for sustainability challenges.
Participate in projects for data consolidation and emission reduction.
Solve moderately complex issues with minimal supervision while escalating more complex issues to SCS Specialist.
Assist in the identification and evaluation of suppliers based on the set sustainability criteria.
Foster relationships with suppliers to promote sustainable practices.
Participate in audits and assessments of supplier’s sustainability practices.
Assist in the audit process to verify supplier decarbonisation efforts.
Follow the reduce, reuse and recycle principle.

pcs.pc_description: Identify and track sustainability metrics related to warehouse operations.
Assist in preparing reports on the energy efficiency metrics of the warehouse.
Check the usage of energy-efficient lighting such as LED lighting, solar panels and energy management systems are used.
Check the usage of eco-friendly materials, green roofing, etc.
Check if resources like water and materials are managed to minimise waste and optimise usage are managed such as water and materials to minimise waste and optimise usage.
Prepare reports on water consumption and wastage.
Collect data on inhouse transport emissions.
Assist in the implementation of automated solutions to reduce the amount of paperwork.
Support in implementing storage systems that are compact and automated.
Assist in the evaluation of the warehouse location and its impact on sustainability performance.
Support in implementing best practices in inventory management and material handling to reduce environmental impact.
Check if sustainable packaging procedures are being followed.
Fill relevant documents for pursuing sustainable certifications for the warehouse (e.g. LEED certification).

pcs.pc_description: Identify and track sustainability metrics related to warehouse operations.
Collect data on transportation-related emissions and energy use.
Collect data on the fuel emissions by the company’s fleet.
Participate in the promotion of the use of electric or hybrid vehicles and other eco-friendly technologies.
Check for optimisation of transport routes to reduce mileage, minimise empty backhauls and increase vehicle utilisation.
Check for the usage of consolidation of shipments wherever possible.
Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to ensure they adhere to the company’s sustainability standards and policies.
Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in sustainable transport.
Assist in the implementation of plans to address transportation-related environmental incidents or emergencies.
Support the enforcement of policies that support sustainable transport initiatives, including guidelines for reducing emissions, energy use, and waste.
Assist with compliance with local, national, and international environmental regulations.
Fill out relevant documents to pursue sustainability certifications and standards for transport operations. (e.g., ISO 14001, SmartWay).
